theater: 美索不達米亞下扎布河谷

battle.name: 下博之戰
battle.theater: 美索不達米亞下扎布河谷
battle.brief: 公元622年，哈立德·伊本·瓦利德率阿拉伯聯軍在美索不達米亞下扎布河兩汊之間，擊潰薩珊王朝羅斯泰姆·法魯赫扎德的大軍，主帥與大將相繼陣亡。波斯步兵仍列羅馬—拜占庭式大盾，即方陣盾的嫡系；阿拉伯部族戰士則幾乎無甲無盾，全靠騎兵機動與兩翼包抄取勝。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 交戰的兩方是剛剛立國的阿拉伯拉希敦哈里發國與美索不達米亞的薩珊波斯帝國。阿拉伯方面由第二任哈里發歐麥爾·伊本·赫塔卜下令出兵，戰場指揮權交給哈立德·伊本·瓦利德；他率領的是以阿拉伯部族民兵為主體的聯軍，旗下有阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜、阿瑪爾·本·雅西爾、祖拜爾·本·阿瓦德、奧斯曼·本·阿尼爾等分率本族兵力的首領，另有自希拉歸附的阿拉伯化波斯人與伊拉克的基督徒社群提供射手與工匠。波斯方面，國王雅茲德格德三世坐鎮泰西封，野戰總指揮是兼掌軍政的羅斯泰姆·法魯赫扎德，麾下有維齊爾達德布納德、各地世襲軍區總督所領的聯軍，並有薩珊重騎兵、鎧甲步軍與弓箭手。營地設在下扎布河兩汊之間的平原上，背靠河流，退路只有一條。同時在北方邊境，拜占庭帝國正與薩珊交戰，雙方邊軍各由本國將領節制，未曾投入本戰。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the newborn Arab Rashidun Caliphate and the Sasanian Persian Empire in Mesopotamia. On the Arab side the second caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab ordered the campaign and handed battlefield command to Khalid ibn al-Walid. His force was a tribal confederation whose backbone was the armed clans of Arabia, led by commanders such as Ali ibn Abi Talib, Ammar ibn Yasir, Zubayr ibn al-Awtab and Uthman ibn al-Anil, reinforced by Arabised Persians from Hira and by the Christian communities of Iraq, who supplied archers and craftsmen. On the Persian side the shah Yazdegerd III stayed at Ctesiphon while field command was held by Rostam Farrokhzad, who combined military and political authority; under him served the vizier Dadbunad, the hereditary commanders of the frontier provinces with their own contingents, and the Sasanian heavy cavalry, armoured infantry and archers. The Persian camp was pitched on the plain between the two branches of the Lower Zab, with the river at its back and only one line of retreat. At the same time the Byzantine Empire was fighting the Sasanians along the northern frontier, but neither side's frontier troops took part in this battle.
people: 核心人物是哈立德·伊本·瓦利德。他出自麥加的瓦利德氏族，父親瓦利德·伊本·穆吉拉是城中的富商與領袖，他本人以「真主之劍」之名行走軍中；此役之後他連下泰西封、耶路撒冷與大馬士革，被後世視為伊斯蘭早期最具攻擊性的統帥。哈里發歐麥爾·伊本·赫塔卜是這次遠征的決策者，他挑中薩珊被拜占庭拖住的窗口，把戰線推進到帝國心臟地帶；同時他對哈立德功高震主早有戒心，戰後不久便把哈立德調往埃及與敘利亞。波斯方面，羅斯泰姆·法魯赫扎德是薩珊最後一位能獨力統兵的大將，久經戰陣，卻在本役兵敗身死；他的同僚維齊爾達德布納德同時陣亡。部族首領中，阿里與祖拜爾直接指揮騎兵迂回，阿瑪爾·本·雅西爾率軍負責中央的正面牽制。烏拜達·伊本·賈拉赫在沙漠邊境執行牽制，他早前在布宰塔的失利幾乎葬送整個計畫。希拉的最後一任君主在城陷後出逃，據說在泰西封附近被追殺。
peopleEn: The central figure is Khalid ibn al-Walid. He came from the Walid clan of Mecca, his father al-Walid ibn al-Mughira being one of the leading merchants of the city, and he fought under the name of the Sword of God. After this campaign he took Ctesiphon, Jerusalem and Damascus in turn, and later tradition has counted him the most aggressive of the early commanders. Caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab was the man who decided on the expedition, choosing the window in which the Sasanians were pinned down by Byzantium so as to drive the war into the heart of the empire; at the same time he was already wary of Khalid's towering reputation and transferred him to Egypt and Syria shortly afterwards. For the Persians, Rostam Farrokhzad was the last great captain able to command a field army on his own, a man of enormous experience, yet he was defeated and killed here; his colleague the vizier Dadbunad fell with him. Among the tribal commanders Ali and Zubayr led the cavalry envelopment in the fighting itself, while Ammar ibn Yasir was responsible for the frontal holding of the centre. Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah carried out the diversion on the desert flank, and his earlier defeat at al-Buzaitha had almost ruined the whole plan. The last ruler of Hira fled after the fall of the city and is said to have been hunted down and killed near Ctesiphon.
kits: 任務指定的兵器是羅馬方陣盾（Scutum），公元前一世紀已入軍用，凸面長方形，寬約六十至九十公分、高可及肩，盾緣加金屬包邊，排成戰陣時盾與盾咬合成連續防壁，靠的是盾緣相扣而不是盾體厚實。帝國晚期這種方形盾已讓位給拜占庭的橢圓形「斯科通」，兩者一脈相承；希臘化世界與薩珊波斯沿用的，正是同一套盾牌技術譜系。落到本役，薩珊步兵所用的就是這一支：重裝步兵配大橢圓盾或匙形盾，近衛與部分騎兵用圓盾，都與羅馬方陣盾同源；羅斯泰姆的營壘與步兵防線也以大盾列壁。更有意思的是其後攻泰西封時，守軍把盾牌豎起當作壁障，用來遮蔽城外的撞槌與弓箭手，方陣盾的防禦功能在這裡變成了遮蔽攻城器械的活牆。相對地，阿拉伯部族戰士在這場戰役中幾乎無甲無盾，多半只著長袍纏頭巾，持矛、弓箭與少量刀劍，馬也不披鎧；正因為對手有盾牆而自己沒有，兩軍裝備落差大得驚人。波斯重騎兵另配長矛、鎧甲與薩珊弓，阿拉伯一方則靠希拉繳獲的攻城器械、皮囊筏與舟橋把戰力推到城下。
kitsEn: The weapon attached to this card is the Roman scutum, in service since the first century BC: a convex rectangle roughly sixty to ninety centimetres wide and tall enough to cover the body, with metal edging along the rim, so that when the line closed up the shields interlocked into a continuous wall. The point of such a shield was the way rim locked into rim, not the thickness of the board. By late imperial times the rectangular form had given way to the oval Byzantine skouton, a direct descendant, and the Hellenistic world and Sasanian Persia both worked within that same technical family of shields. In this campaign the Sasanian infantry used precisely that family: heavy infantry with large oval or spoon-shaped shields, guards and some cavalry with round shields, all descended from the Roman scutum, and Rostam's camp and infantry line were walled with big shields. More telling is what happened later, in the siege of Ctesiphon, where the defenders stood their shields up as mantlets to shield the rams and the archers of the besiegers; the defensive function of the scutum turned there into a living wall for covering siege engines. By contrast the Arab tribal warriors in this battle were almost without armour and without shields, wearing little more than a tunic and a headcloth and carrying spears, bows and a few swords, and their horses were unarmoured too; the equipment gulf between the two sides, one side walled in shields and the other with none at all, was enormous. The Persian heavy cavalry carried lances, armour and the Sasanian bow, while the Arab side relied on siege engines captured at Hira, on hides inflated as pontoons and on boats to carry its strength up to the city walls.
tactics: 這場戰役的關鍵不是正面硬撼，而是把敵人釘在一個退不掉的袋子裡。哈立德先用皮囊與小舟在底格里斯河上架起浮橋，據記載他曾以一塊黑石固定橋纜，全軍越河北上直抵下扎布河；同時他派烏拜達·伊本·賈拉赫向沙漠邊境與薩珊側翼施壓，讓波斯方面誤以為主攻來自東南方。接著他把聯軍拆成若干部族的分段縱隊，以中軍為軸線，不與波斯大軍全面接觸，只以小股騎兵反覆試探，消耗對手的推進力。決戰當日，羅斯泰姆的中軍前壓時，哈立德命前鋒「敗退」：前隊且戰且退，把追擊的波斯騎兵拉成一條擠壓變形的密集縱隊，與本隊拉開距離；待波斯陣線鬆散、左右兩翼失去銜接，埋伏在兩側的蘇萊姆、塔米姆、基納尼、艾薩德等部族騎兵同時兜擊側背，中央縱隊隨即合圍反打。這就是全戰役的殺招：誘敵離陣加兩翼包抄。退路方面，波斯軍位置於兩汊之間的平原，回撤時必須爭先涉水渡河，隊形在河岸與水中大亂，溺斃與被俘者甚多，營壘、軍械與王庭財貨盡數落入阿拉伯軍手中。戰後阿拉伯軍以繳獲的攻城器械與嚮導沿底格里斯河直趨泰西封。
tacticsEn: The key to this battle was not a frontal slog but the pinning of the enemy in a place from which he could not withdraw. Khalid first threw a floating bridge of hides and small boats across the Tigris; the account runs that he used a black stone to hold the bridge cables, and the whole army crossed to the north and closed on the Lower Zab. At the same time he sent Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah to press the desert frontier and the Sasanian flank, so that the Persians believed the main blow would come from the south-east. He then split the confederation into tribal echelons, a tribal army deployed in segmented columns around a central axis, refusing to offer general battle to the whole Persian host and content to send in small bodies of horse to probe and wear down the enemy's offensive weight. On the day of decision, when Rostam's centre pressed forward, Khalid ordered the van to feign flight: the forward line fought and withdrew, drawing the pursuing Persian cavalry into a crowded, deformed column stretched away from the main body. Once the Persian line had loosened and its two wings had lost contact, the tribal horse hidden on both flanks, the Sulaym, the Tamim, the Kinana and the Asad, struck the rear and flanks simultaneously, and the central columns closed and counterattacked. That was the killing stroke of the whole battle: luring the enemy out of formation and then attacking from both wings. As for the retreat, the Persian army stood on a plain between the two branches of the river, so that to fall back it had to crowd into the water; the formation dissolved at the bank and in the current, many were drowned or taken prisoner, and the camp, the weapons and the royal treasure all fell into Arab hands. The Arab army then used the captured siege engines and the guides it had taken to march straight down the Tigris towards Ctesiphon.
data: 兵力數字各家說法不一，只能當作量級參考。阿拉伯方面的聯軍一般記為二萬至三萬人，其中騎兵佔相當比重；波斯方面的野戰部隊通常記為約三萬，內有重騎兵、鎧甲步軍與弓箭手，羅斯泰姆麾下還有若干位封疆總督各領一軍。地理與時間上，下扎布河即小扎布河，由東北向西南流，在今土耳其東南部與伊拉克北部邊境一帶匯入底格里斯河，營地正夾在河身兩汊之間的平原上，縱深不過數公里，一旦被逼向河岸便無處可退。決戰本身一般記為一天，此前有數日小戰與前哨接觸。損失方面，羅斯泰姆與達德布納德陣亡，波斯軍的陣亡與溺斃總數在阿拉伯方面的記載中從一萬到數萬都有，差距過大，只能視為上限式的說法；阿拉伯軍自身的損失則沒有可靠數字可循。可以確定的時間座標是：619 年哈立德攻取希拉，622 年初在下博河擊潰波斯主力，624 年 12 月拜占庭皇帝赫拉克利烏斯在尼尼微大敗同名的波斯將領；那一位與本役陣亡的羅斯泰姆同名而不同人，兩條戰線的同時代記載常被後人混為一談。
dataEn: The strength figures vary from source to source and can only be used as orders of magnitude. The Arab confederation is generally given as twenty to thirty thousand men, with cavalry forming a substantial share; the Persian field army is usually put at about thirty thousand, made up of heavy cavalry, armoured infantry and archers, with several frontier commanders serving under Rostam each leading a detachment of his own. Geographically and chronologically, the Zab, the Lesser Zab, runs from the north-east to the south-west and joins the Tigris in the belt of modern south-eastern Turkey and northern Iraq, and the camp stood exactly on the plain between the two branches of the river, a few kilometres deep, so that once a man was driven towards the bank there was nowhere left to go. The decisive action itself is generally reckoned to have lasted a single day, preceded by several days of minor engagements and contact. On losses, Rostam and Dadbunad were killed, while the total of Persian dead and drowned runs in the Arab accounts from ten thousand to tens of thousands; the spread is too wide to be trusted and the figure should be read as an upper bound. No reliable figure survives for Arab casualties. The chronological markers that can be fixed are these: 619, when Khalid took Hira; early 622, when the Persian main force was destroyed at the Zab; and December 624, when the Byzantine emperor Heraclius beat a Persian general of the same name at Nineveh. That man was a namesake, not the Rostam who died here, and contemporary accounts of the two fronts are constantly confused by later writers.
cause: 打起來的原因是薩珊帝國同時在兩條戰線透支了國力。皇帝庫思老二世自 602 年起與拜占庭打了七年消耗戰，傾國力於西線，把美索不達米亞與亞美尼亞的兵員、稅收與糧草都抽去與拜占庭對峙，北線自 615 年以後便只剩邊防性質的殘部；東面對付阿拉伯部落的邊軍規模有限，遠不足以支撐一場會戰。就在此時，阿拉伯半島完成了統一，拉希敦政權先後取希拉、艾什努布，並在葉門擊潰支持薩珊的阿比西尼亞聯軍，切斷了帝國在阿拉伯半島南翼的依賴，直接把邊境推到薩珊腹地。哈里發歐麥爾在 622 年決定抓住這個窗口：既然薩珊主力被拜占庭牽制在北方，就應主動進擊美索不達米亞，目標直指首都泰西封。直接導火是哈立德與烏拜達在邊境試探時發現薩珊兵力調度遲緩、縱深空虛，於是請求批准全面進攻，歐麥爾應允，軍隊於齋月之後開入伊拉克。薩珊這邊的內部弊病同樣致命：宮廷鬥爭、地方總督擁兵自重、摩尼教在美索不達米亞的「米爾德」運動牽制了邊軍，戰前能集中於下扎布河的野戰兵力，遠少於帝國鼎盛時的規模。
causeEn: The reason the war came about was that the Sasanian Empire had overdrawn itself on two fronts at once. Since 602 the emperor Khosrow II had been fighting Byzantium for seven years of attrition, pouring the resources of the state into the western theatre and drawing troops, taxes and grain out of Mesopotamia and Armenia to face the Byzantines; after 615 the northern frontier was held by little more than token garrisons, while the eastern frontier force that faced the Arab clans was too small to sustain a pitched battle. Meanwhile the Arabian peninsula had completed its unification. The Rashidun state took Hira and then Ushnana, and in Yemen defeated the Abyssinian army that supported the Sasanians, cutting the empire off from its southern flank and pushing the frontier deep into Sasanian territory. In 622 caliph Umar decided to seize that window: since the Sasanian main army was tied down in the north by Byzantium, the war should be carried into Mesopotamia with the capital at Ctesiphon as the goal. The immediate occasion was the scouting of Khalid and Ubayda along the frontier, which showed the Sasanian forces slow to concentrate and hollow in depth; they asked for permission to attack in earnest, Umar gave it, and the army entered Iraq after the fast of Ramadan. The internal lesions of the Sasanian state were just as serious: quarrels in the palace, satraps with armies of their own, and the Manichaean mird movement in Mesopotamia tying down the frontier troops. The field army that could be assembled at the Zab before the battle was far smaller than anything the empire could have raised in its prime.
impact: 此役是薩珊波斯的終局開端。野戰主力覆沒、羅斯泰姆陣亡、泰西封門戶洞開，國王雅茲德格德三世帶著少量隨從東逃，數年後在木鹿附近被殺，延續六百餘年的薩珊帝國就此落幕，波斯大部分疆土落入哈里發國家版圖。伊拉克隨後成為哈里發國的核心都督區，泰西封與艾什努布成為新的行政與商業中心，敘利亞—埃及線與伊朗高原被同一個政權連成一體。就軍事技術而言，這也是羅馬防禦譜系的一次總清算：薩珊大盾所代表的希臘化—羅馬步兵盾牆傳統，在這場會戰後隨帝國崩潰而中斷，伊斯蘭軍隊以騎兵與輕步兵為骨幹，並沒有承接這套技術；同一譜系的拜占庭「斯科通」則在北方獨自延續了半個多世紀，直到 7 世紀末才在耶利哥與亞美尼亞方向的戰役中隨拜占庭帝國的解體而告終。長期看，此役也是「波斯化」的開端：薩珊的官僚、稅制、波斯馬兵傳統與地方都督制，後來被哈里發國家吸收重組，深刻影響了倭馬亞與阿拔斯時期的軍事與財政制度。
impactEn: This battle opened the endgame of Sasanian Persia. The field army was destroyed, Rostam was killed, the gates of Ctesiphon stood open, and the shah Yazdegerd III fled east with a handful of followers to be killed near Merv some years later; the Sasanian Empire, which had ruled for more than six centuries, came to an end, and the greater part of Persia passed into the caliphate's territory. Iraq became the core administrative district of the new state, with Ctesiphon and Ushnana as its political and commercial centres, and the Syria-Egypt axis was joined to the Iranian plateau under a single government. In terms of military technology the campaign was also a general reckoning with the Roman defensive tradition: the great Sasanian shields, carriers of the Hellenistic-Roman shield-wall idea, lost their line of transmission once the empire broke, and the Islamic armies, built on cavalry and light infantry, took nothing over from it. The Byzantine skouton, of the same family, continued alone in the north for half a century more and only ended with the dissolution of the Byzantine state in the campaigns towards Jericho and Armenia in the late seventh century. In the long run the battle also opened the period of Persianisation: the Sasanian bureaucracy, taxation, Persian horse traditions and provincial satrapy were absorbed and reorganised by the caliphate, and they deeply shaped the military and fiscal systems of the Umayyad and Abbasid periods.
result: 阿拉伯軍取得的是一場完勝：羅斯泰姆與達德布納德陣亡，波斯野戰部隊被成建制擊潰，潰退中爭渡下扎布河而溺斃與被俘者甚眾，薩珊營壘、武器、攻城器械與國庫財貨盡成戰利品。哈立德隨即率軍沿底格里斯河直逼泰西封，628 年起圍城，至 630 至 631 年間攻破城區與城堡，薩珊在美索不達米亞的中樞控制徹底瓦解；雅茲德格德三世出逃，帝國在其被殺後正式終結。但戰爭並未在此役結束：各地總督與地方貴族仍據城抵抗，戰事延續多年，這場下博之戰只是總崩潰的起點而非結算。人事上，歐麥爾因哈立德勢力過大而將其外調埃及與敘利亞，這種哈里發與戰功將領之間的張力此後長期存在。戰術層面則留下清晰範式：以地形封死退路、誘敵離陣、兩翼騎兵兜擊，再以崩潰後的追擊放大戰果，這套組合此後被阿拉伯各朝的兵書反覆引用。
resultEn: The Arab army won outright: Rostam and Dadbunad were killed, the Persian field army was destroyed as an organised force, and in the rout the men drowned or were taken prisoner while pressing to cross the Lower Zab; the Sasanian camp, its weapons, its siege engines and the treasury's wealth all became booty. Khalid marched straight down the Tigris to Ctesiphon, besieged it from 628 and broke the city and its citadel around 630 to 631, so that Sasanian control of Mesopotamia collapsed at the centre; Yazdegerd III fled, and the empire ended formally with his death. The war, however, did not end with this battle: provincial governors and local notables held their cities for years more, and the Zab was the opening of a general collapse rather than its settlement. On the personal side, Umar removed Khalid to Egypt and Syria because his standing army and prestige had grown too large, and that tension between caliph and victorious general persisted for a long time afterwards. At the tactical level the campaign left a clear template: use the ground to seal the enemy's retreat, lure him out of formation, bring the wings of horse against his flanks, then multiply the effect with the pursuit; this combination was quoted and reworked in the military manuals of the later Arab dynasties.
